svg.title: British Columbia / Park Ranger — 174
svg.desc: Clean designed reconstruction of the photographed badge. Smooth geometry and outlined type replace all image-derived contours. Relief, hammered grain, ageing, reflections and display stands are omitted. Exact original typeface, die engraving and material tones cannot be authenticated; the few silver/bronze fills are a material interpretation. The shared numbered Park Ranger template retains the serial, broad silhouette profile and full versus simplified armorial distinction. Lower edges hidden by display stands are completed from the matching family outline. The visible old armorial edition uses the exact user-selected Plateforge 1917-late / Type 3 component with stroke weight 3 and uniform fit. Plateforge describes its source as a vector conversion of a generated master; it is not an authenticated original die, engraving or embroidery master.
